podcast.body: Featured on the 1984 *Zen Arcade* album, this song tells a tragic part of the album's narrative, describing the protagonist joining the military, becoming a Hare Krishna, finding a girl, and ultimately losing her to drugs. It is noted for its innovative use of pop elements within a hardcore punk framework. "Take note of the pop elements used to create this hardcore punk song."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This track from the "Zen Arcade" album exemplifies early emo elements, despite the term "emo" not yet existing. It features themes of drug addiction, loss, and death, which are delivered against a backdrop of serious, intense guitars. "The song about drug addiction and loss and death. But everything is set against some serious guitars."
